mapper.select: SELECT r.*, d.device_name, d.device_no, u.real_name AS user_name FROM repair_record r LEFT JOIN device d ON r.device_id = d.id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repair_record WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND repair_status IN (0, 1)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO repair_record(device_id, user_id, fault_desc, repair_status, report_time) VALUES(#{deviceId}, #{userId}, #{faultDesc}, #{repairStatus}, #{reportTime})
